entries.text: Do you want to challenge the strange Pokémon?
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_system_01

entries.text: Hmm? What are we all doing here?[VAR 0x0114(0031)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_man_01

entries.text: How did I end up at Loyalty Plaza?[VAR 0x0114(0036)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_woman_01

entries.text: The last thing I remember is getting to the shop...\nWhat happened?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_friend_02

entries.text: So, first... ... ... And after that... ... ...\nBut then they all... ... ...![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_brother_04

entries.text: So all that “mochi mochi” stuff was because of\nsome Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_friend_04

entries.text: See? SEE?! I told you it was real! Unlike dumb\nhorror movie tropes like curses![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_botan_01

entries.text: That round little monster was behind everything!\nJust like I said![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_botan_02

entries.text: Errr... When did you say that?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_friend_05

entries.text: Huh? What’s going on? Did we find the remote?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_rival_03

entries.text: THAT’S what you want to know?!\c\nSheesh. Glad you’re back to normal now, at least.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_friend_08

entries.text: Y’know, I had this crazy realistic dream that I was\nbattling [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_rival_05

entries.text: It was awesome! Sign me up to have that dream\nagain! Hahaha![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_rival_06

entries.text: What the heck is going on?! Why is everyone\nup here?! Someone better start explaining![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_sister_02

entries.text: Actually... Huh. What a weird feeling...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_sister_03

entries.text: Somehow it feels like...I’m seeing you for the\nfirst time in ages.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_sister_04

entries.text: My arms and legs are still killing me from all that\ndancing...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_botan_npc

entries.text: All packed here! Everyone got their stuff\ntogether?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_rival_npc

entries.text: So we’re heading back to Paldea already, huh?\c\nWe got caught up in a pretty hairy situation, but\nthis trip was still a blast![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0190_friend_npc
